Standard: The air vehicle's bank angle response in forward flight (greater than 45 KGS) is no worse than Level 2 flying qualities as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Bank Angle Oscillations paragraph, unless pilot evaluation determines the air vehicle handling qualities are no worse than Level 2. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis to assess bank angle oscillations in forward flight as specified in MIL-DTL- 327142, Roll-Sideslip Coupling and Bank Angle Oscillations paragraphs for each air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess bank angle oscillations in forward flight as specified in MIL-DTL-327142, Roll-Sideslip Coupling and Bank Angle Oscillations paragraphs for each air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess bank angle oscillations in forward flight as specified in MIL-DTL-327142, Roll-Sideslip Coupling and Bank Angle Oscillations paragraphs for selected combinations of air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE.
